# Example service

Use the navigation below to find the service contracts.

## Intent

Researchers can inspect original observations and later corrections.

### Boundaries

The service preserves observation history.

## Requirements

Every correction retains the original value. See the [observation contract](docs/observations.md).

## Architecture

The recorder owns the history. See the [storage contract](docs/storage.md).

## Local Instructions

Run the repository checks before proposing a change.

## Navigation

Read the service directory.
